title: The Last Light Square notice board still prints the original 'settle the king in it and the doors are to be sealed' text verbatim on 'read the notice board again' even after the Hollow King is fully rested and the doors already resolved — every other town fixture (reeve, priest, Herald Corvane) got updated post-resolution lines, but the board did not.
